tagline: Clinical-stage oncology company developing alpha-emitting brachytherapy for solid tumors
hero_kpi_rationale: The complete response rate (78.6%) is the primary clinical efficacy indicator of DaRT treatment, reflecting its disruptive therapeutic potential in a high unmet medical need area.

kpis.name: Complete Response Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of lesions that completely disappeared after treatment.
kpis.description: Out of 28 evaluable lesions, 22 showed complete tumor disappearance 30 to 45 days after DaRT treatment.

kpis.name: Partial Response Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of lesions that reduced in size by more than 30%.
kpis.description: 6 out of 28 lesions reduced their volume by more than 30%, without achieving complete disappearance.
kpis.signal: 100% of patients achieved a tumor response (complete or partial)

kpis.name: Local PFS (1-year)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of treated lesions that did not locally recur after 1 year.
kpis.description: The overall probability of no local recurrence at 1 year is 44%, but increases to 60% in patients achieving complete response.
kpis.signal: Local recurrence observed in 22% of complete responders

kpis.name: Overall Survival (12mo)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of patients still alive 12 months after treatment.
kpis.description: 75% of patients enrolled in the study were still alive 12 months after DaRT treatment, 93% among complete responders.
kpis.signal: High survival rate despite advanced and recurrent cancers

kpis.name: Adverse Events Grade <3
kpis.explanation: Absence of severe adverse events observed (all adverse events were grade <3).
kpis.description: Side effects were limited to local pain, erythema, swelling, and benign skin ulcerations, resolved within 3 to 5 weeks in 90% of patients.

kpis.name: Patient Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of patients included in the clinical study.
kpis.description: The study enrolled 28 patients across two medical centers (Israel and Italy) between February 2017 and March 2019.
kpis.signal: Initial cohort of 28 patients in a multicenter trial

kpis.name: R&D Expenses (2025)
kpis.explanation: Net research and development expenses for the year 2025.
kpis.description: Net R&D expenses increased by 5,045 K USD (18.7%) from 27,020 K USD in 2024 to 32,065 K USD in 2025, primarily due to increased employee compensation, raw material costs, and external vendor expenses.

kpis.name: Total Operating Loss (2025)
kpis.explanation: Total operating loss for the year 2025.
kpis.description: Total operating loss increased by 6,246 K USD (17.3%) from 36,042 K USD in 2024 to 42,288 K USD in 2025, reflecting higher R&D investments and general overhead costs.

kpis.name: Net Loss (2025)
kpis.description: Net loss increased by 10,877 K USD (34.3%) from 31,750 K USD in 2024 to 42,627 K USD in 2025, primarily due to higher operating loss and financial expenses.

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents (2025)
kpis.explanation: Cash and cash equivalents balance as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents amounted to 12,202 K USD as of December 31, 2025. Combined with short-term deposits (60,924 K USD) and restricted deposits (3,777 K USD), total liquidity reached 76,903 K USD.
kpis.signal: Available cash of 76.9 M USD including short-term deposits

kpis.name: Total Liquidity (2025)
kpis.explanation: Total liquidity including cash, short-term deposits, and restricted deposits.
kpis.description: Total liquidity as of December 31, 2025 was 76,903 K USD, consisting of 12,202 K USD in cash, 60,924 K USD in short-term deposits, and 3,777 K USD in restricted deposits. The company estimates this liquidity can fund operations for at least two years.
kpis.signal: Liquidity position of 76.9 M USD supporting at least 2 years of operations

kpis.name: Operating Cash Burn (2025)
kpis.explanation: Negative operating cash flows for the year 2025.
kpis.description: Cash used in operating activities increased by 6,898 K USD (34.9%) from 19,783 K USD in 2024 to 26,681 K USD in 2025, primarily due to a 10,877 K USD increase in net loss.
kpis.signal: Operating cash burn of 26.7 M USD, up 34.9% year-on-year

risks.title: Lack of revenue and chronic operating losses
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 1A (dominant position), highly intense language ("significant losses", "accumulated deficit $190M"), stable/increasing trend (losses 2024-2025), critical weight for business viability.

risks.title: Critical dependence on radioisotope supply
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk explicitly cited in forward-looking statements ("unable to obtain sufficient supply"), medium-high intensity language, stable trend (structural constraint), high weight for commercial scalability.

risks.title: Innovative technology with unpredictable development risks
risks.score_rationale: Core business risk explicitly mentioned ("novel approach creates significant and potentially unpredictable challenges"), high-intensity language, stable trend (inherent to model), major weight as it affects entire R&D strategy.

risks.title: Multijurisdictional regulatory and marketing approval risks
risks.score_rationale: Dominant business risk cited three times in forward-looking statements (FDA approvals, foreign authorizations, delays), highly intense language ("extensive government regulation", "failure to timely obtain"), stable trend, critical weight for commercialization.

risks.title: Clinical acceptance and public perception of radiation therapy
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk explicitly cited ("public perception of radiation therapies"), medium-intensity language, stable trend, moderate weight as dependent on external factors (patient/physician perception).

risks.title: Lack of commercial and marketing capabilities
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk ("no experience in marketing", "unable to establish marketing and sales capabilities"), medium-high intensity language, stable trend, high weight for post-approval phase.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection and infringement risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited business risk ("unable to obtain and maintain patent protection"), medium-high intensity language, stable trend, high weight for sustainable competitive advantage.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks related to Israel operations
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk cited at conclusion ("Conditions in Israel could materially and adversely affect"), medium-intensity language, stable/increasing trend (current geopolitical context), moderate but rising weight.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company focuses on alpha-emitting brachytherapy technology (DaRT) with no reference to AI.
